item.title: Mac Resource Monitor 1.4.3
item.description:
• Fixed: the graphs on the dashboard cards now keep their scale labels in a dedicated column to the left of the plot, so the numbers no longer sit on top of the line and become unreadable once a card has a full history.

Since 1.4.1:

  • Fixed: Gatekeeper no longer reports the app as unverified on a fresh download.
  • New: Intel Mac support — the app ships as a universal binary, so it runs on Intel Macs on macOS 14 or later. Power draw and per-chip stats that depend on Apple Silicon hardware are simply hidden there.
